style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Rose and Gyp Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Transform any space into a romantic haven with this beautiful 95cm rose and gyp garland. This stunning garland features lush, lifelike roses intertwined with delicate gypsophila (baby’s breath), creating a timeless and elegant decoration perfect for any occasion. Perfect for any occasion, this garland can be draped over mantels, wrapped around banisters, or used as a table runner for weddings, parties, or everyday elegance. Garland length: L95cm. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Dimensions(mm): Height: 950 Width: 100 Depth: 90
